found_on: tradable pairs 2021-01..2026-09 (data/laya_daily_labels.jsonl): first-hour excess <= -10% -> 5-day excess short +12.3% mean (n=388), monotone in the threshold
rule: regular-session news 09:31-15:30 ET on a stock; first_hour = SPY-hedged return from the open of the first 1-min bar >= news+60s to 60 minutes later (flattened 15:50 ET); if first_hour <= -10% (first qualifying news per stock and day): SHORT at the news day's close, cover at the close 5 trading days later; P&L = stock return minus SPY's over the same closes
primary_metric: mean and median 5-day SPY-hedged short return after 0.5% cost, clustered by entry day
pass_if: hold-out mean > 0 with day-clustered t > 2 and median > 0
hold_outs: pairs the bot's price/liquidity gates skip (tradable=false), same years
